notes: Corrects a misleading backup message. In 0.7, a backup saved to a location the app could not read back was reported as FAILED, with advice to delete it. That was wrong: not being able to check a backup is not the same as the backup being bad, and the file was very probably fine. There are now three outcomes instead of two - saved and checked, failed the check (genuinely bad, delete it), and saved but not checked (written, unproven, keep it). If you want a backup proved, saving it to the tablet's own storage such as Downloads can normally be read back and verified; copy it elsewhere afterwards. Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
